sections.description:
REGULATION II OF 2000
FEDERALLY
ADMINISTERED TRIBAL AREAS DEVELOPMENT CORPORATION (AMENDMENT) REGULATION, 2000
REGULATION II OF 2000
A Regulation
further to amend the Federally Administered Tribal Areas Development
Corporation Regulation, 1970
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I, 19th August, 2000]
No.2(3)/2000-Pub., dated
19-8-2000.---The following Regulation made by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Federally Administered, Tribal Areas Development Corporation
Regulation, 1970 (II of 1970), for the purposes hereinafter appearing;
Now, therefore, in exercise of
the powers conferred by clause (5) of Article 247 of the Constitution of the
Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the President is pleased to make the following
Regulation:
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Regulation may be called the Federally Administered
Tribal Areas Development Corporation (Amendment) Regulation, 2000.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.
2. Amendment of section 2,
Regulation II of 1970.--In the Federally Administered Tribal Areas
Development Corporation Regulation, 1970 (II of 1970), hereinafter referred to
as the said Regulation, in section 2,--
(1) for clause (e) the following
shall be substituted, namely:--
"(e)
'Chairman' means Chairman of the Board;' and
(2) after clause (i) the
following new clause shall be inserted, namely:--
" (ia)
'Managing Director' means the Managing Director of the Corporation;".
3. Amendment of section 5,
Regulation II of 1970.-In the said Regulation, in section 5,--
(1) for subsection (1), the
following shall be substituted, namely:--
(1) There shall be Board of
Directors which shall consist of--
(a)
Governor-West Frontier Province, who shall ex-officio, be the Chairman of the
Board;
(b) Managing
Director who shall be a whole time officer of the Corporation;
(c) Joint
Secretary to the Federal Government in the States and Frontier Regions
Division;
(d) Financial
Adviser, States and F.R. Division, Government of Pakistan;
(e) Secretary
Home and Tribal Affairs, N.-W.F.P.
(f) Secretary,
Finance, N.-W.F.P.
(g) Secretary,
Planning and Development, N.-W.F.P.
(h)
Commissioners, Kohat, Bannu, D.I. Khan and Peshawar; and
(i) such other
officers or persons to be appointed as Directors of the Board by the Chairman
with prior approval of the Federal Government."
(2) For subsection (2) the
following shall be substituted, namely:--
"(2) The Managing Director,
who shall be the Chief Executive and official spokesman of the Corporation and
the Board, shall hold office during the pleasure of the Federal Government and,
the directors referred to in clause (i) of subsection (1), unless removed
earlier, shall hold office for a period of three years and may be appointed
thereafter for a further term or terms of such duration as the Chairman may,
with approval of the Federal Government, determine."; and
(3) for subsection (5) the
following shall be substituted, namely:--
"(5) The Managing Director,
or any other director of the Board, may at any time resign his office by
writing under his hand addressed to the Chairman:
Provided that no such resignation
shall take effect until it is accepted by the Federal Government."
4. Substitution of section 6,
Regulation II of 1970.--In the said Regulation, for section 6 the following
shall be substituted, namely:--
"6. Remuneration
and the conditions of service of the Managing Director.--The Managing
Director shall receive such salary and allowances and shall be subject to such
conditions of service as the Chairman may, with the approval of the Federal
Government determine."
?

Regulation II of 1970.-- In the said Regulation, in section 8, after the
word "Chairman" the comma and words "the Managing Director"
shall be inserted.
